title: 第一卷 第3章 干得漂亮本尊的小旗子第一卷 第4章 偷袭不讲武德
slug: 失踪十年小师妹让全宗门跪下迎接
content_zh:
轻烟软红，玉石珠宝。
粉白色的纱帐在香雾缭绕中微微飘荡，室内陈设摆件无一不精致，无一不昂贵，一看便知是极其受宠爱的女修洞府。
此时，身穿一身素色白衣的少女正一脸紧张地坐在桌边，手指绞着衣角。
只听见珠帘被撩动的声音响起。
不一会儿，一道劲瘦挺拔的身影便走了进来。
男子几步走到她的身旁坐下，径自给自己倒了一杯茶，轻嘬一口问道：“怎么了？突然这么着急找我。”
少女抬眸看他，既惶恐又担心地道：“她回来了。”
男子：“谁？”
少女压低声音，一字一顿：“洛、还、真。”
男子眯眸：“怎么可能？她死了。那地方，一个六岁孩子不可能活下来。”
少女咬唇道：“是真的。她没死。她回来了。她想硬闯宗门，被值守弟子拦下发生了争执。雷子越与我恰巧路过，撞上了。我把雷子越叫走，没让他俩多说话。”
她一眼就认出了她。
毕竟，她为了学习她、冒充她，日夜盯着她的留影石观看。那双眼睛，那个神态，那种骨子里的骄傲——哪怕满脸伤疤、浑身脏污，也掩盖不住。
虽然随着时间的流逝，她已经将洛还真残留的形象从几位师兄的心中挤出，自己住了进去。
但所有人都忘记她，自己这个假冒的却永远不会。
少女深吸一口气，缓缓道：“她现在只有炼气一层境界。她的身份令牌也在我手里，她没办法强行证明身份。但她运气好，碰上三年一届的弟子招收大会了。我打听到她现在正在参加入宗测试。”
男子皱眉，凝肃道：“想办法阻止她。不能让她进入宗门。”
他顿了顿，眼中闪过一丝杀意，“明日我要外出，你去申请巡视试炼场的资格，届时直接在试炼中将她斩杀。一个炼气一层的小乞丐，死在入宗测试里，没人会在意。”
少女轻轻点头，柔声道：“嗯。我也这么想的。”
男子伸手抚摸她的发，轻声宽慰道：“别害怕，明月。我会一直在你身后保护你的。十年前我能让她消失，十年后也一样。”

少女——苏明月——轻轻靠进他怀里，眼中柔弱褪去，露出一丝阴狠。
两人又说了一阵儿话。
耳鬓厮磨间，相拥走向床榻。
不一会儿，男欢女爱的声音便从轻飘飘的粉色纱帐中低低传出，又在轻烟香雾中悄悄弥散。
翌日。
日上三竿。
在树底下蜷缩着睡觉的小女童睁开眼睛，打了个大大的哈欠，露出两颗小虎牙。
她从嘴里吐出一根昨晚叼着玩的小草，揉了揉眼睛，又用小脏手把小揪揪扶正，然后朝弟子测试广场走去。
昨天洛还真已经测完了灵根资质。
不知道是不是因为实力被封的缘故，她万古无一的混沌灵根藏起来了，她这个超级大天才，现在是个平平无奇的下品灵根小修士。
不过不重要，先想办法回家再说。
今天第二场测试，也是最后一场测试，是测意志力。
修仙之路，光有灵根不行，还要有意志力。二者相辅相成，方能成就大道。
意志力测试每次三百人。
大家都坐在一个很冻屁股的石蒲团上，闭目凝神后会进入一个虚幻世界。里面会有各种各样的心魔出现，有时候还会独自一人行走很久很久，几百年，甚至是几千年。
唯有经得住诱惑、耐得住寂寞的修士，才能通过考核。
洛还真走到测试场入口，踮起脚尖，把自己的被测资格令牌举过头顶给检查的弟子看。
检查的弟子低头看了看这个只到自己大腿的小团子，又看了看令牌，放她进去了。
洛还真径自找到一个空石蒲团，准备盘腿坐好。但奈何腿太短盘不起来，她只能像只小青蛙一样趴着。
旁边的考生都在憋笑。

洛还真瞪了他们一眼：“看什么看！本尊喜欢这样坐！”
content_en:
Light smoke, soft red, jade jewelry.
The pink and white gauze curtains are floating slightly in the scented mist, and the interior furnishings are all exquisite and expensive. At a glance, you can tell that this is the cave of an extremely beloved female nun.
At this time, a girl wearing plain white clothes was sitting at the table with a nervous look on her face, twisting her clothes with her fingers.
Only the sound of the bead curtain being moved was heard.
After a while, a thin and tall figure walked in.
The man took a few steps to sit next to her, poured himself a cup of tea, took a sip and asked, "What's wrong? You are so anxious to find me all of a sudden."
The girl looked up at him, frightened and worried: "She's back."
Man: "Who?"
The girl lowered her voice and said word by word: "Luo, Huan, Zhen."
The man narrowed his eyes: "How is it possible? She is dead. There is no way a six-year-old child could survive in that place."
The girl bit her lip and said, "It's true. She's not dead. She's back. She wanted to force her way into the sect, but was stopped by the disciples on duty and had an argument. Lei Ziyue and I happened to pass by and bumped into each other. I called Lei Ziyue away and didn't let them talk anymore."
She recognized her immediately.
After all, in order to learn from her and impersonate her, she stared at her image stone day and night. Those eyes, that expression, that pride in the bones - even if the face is covered with scars and the body is dirty, they can't hide it.
Although as time passed, she had squeezed out the remaining image of Luo Huanzhen from the hearts of several senior brothers and lived in it herself.
But everyone forgets her, but this fake one will never.
The girl took a deep breath and said slowly: "She is only at the first level of Qi Refining now. Her identity token is also in my hand, so she can't forcefully prove her identity. But she was lucky enough to attend the disciple recruitment conference that is held every three years. I found out that she is currently participating in the sect entrance test."
The man frowned and said solemnly: "Find a way to stop her. We can't let her enter the sect."
He paused, with a trace of murderous intent flashing in his eyes, "I'm going out tomorrow, and you can apply for the qualification to patrol the trial site. Then I'll kill her directly during the trial. No one will care if a little beggar with a first-level Qi refining dies in the sect entrance test."
The girl nodded slightly and said softly: "Yes. I think so too."
The man reached out to stroke her hair and comforted her softly: "Don't be afraid, Mingyue. I will always be behind you to protect you. I could make her disappear ten years ago, and I will do the same ten years later."
The girl - Su Mingyue - leaned gently into his arms, her eyes softened, revealing a trace of sinisterness.
The two talked for a while.
They hugged each other and walked to the bed while whispering.
After a while, the sounds of love between men and women came out softly from the fluttering pink gauze curtain, and then quietly dispersed in the light smoke and incense.
The next day.
Three poles in the sun.
The little girl who was sleeping curled up under the tree opened her eyes and yawned widely, revealing two small tiger teeth.
She spit out a piece of grass that she had been playing with last night, rubbed her eyes, straightened the grass with her dirty hands, and then walked towards the disciple testing square.
Yesterday, Luo Huanzhen had already tested his spiritual root aptitude.
I don’t know if it’s because her strength was blocked, but her eternal chaotic spiritual root was hidden. She, a super genius, is now an ordinary low-grade spiritual root cultivator.
But it’s not important, let’s find a way to get home first.
The second test today, and also the last test, is a test of willpower.
On the road to immortality, spiritual roots alone are not enough, but also willpower. The two complement each other to achieve great success.
There are three hundred people in each willpower test.
Everyone is sitting on a very cold stone futon, and after closing their eyes and concentrating, they will enter an illusory world. There will be all kinds of inner demons appearing inside, and sometimes you will walk alone for a long time, hundreds, or even thousands of years.
Only monks who can withstand temptation and loneliness can pass the assessment.
Luo HuanzhenHe walked to the entrance of the testing field, stood on tiptoes, and raised his test qualification token above his head to show it to the inspecting disciples.
The inspecting disciple looked down at the small dumpling that only reached his thigh, looked at the token again, and let her in.
Luo Huanzhen found an empty stone futon and prepared to sit cross-legged. But her legs were too short to cross her legs, so she could only lie down like a little frog.
The candidates next to me were suppressing laughter.
Luo really glared at them: "What are you looking at! I like to sit like this!"
